intent: The guesses an agent made without asking, each with confidence, source and the steps that depend on it, so a person can confirm or correct them before they matter. Compact: open count plus the weakest guess.
useWhen: an agent filled a gap on its own (a currency, a date range, a default) and the person should check it
a correction should make the agent redo the steps that used the guess
a run header needs a one-line nudge about open guesses (compact)
doNotUseWhen: the agent asks a question and waits — DecisionCard
facts the agent keeps across sessions — MemoryPanel
a recommendation the person may act on — InsightCard

items.note: { id, text, confidence: 0–1, source?, steps?: string[], status: "open" | "confirmed" | "corrected", correction? }[]. Confidence below 0.5 is Low, below 0.8 Medium, else High. Open rows sort weakest first. Confidence shows the word and the percent ("Low 46%").

filter.note: SegmentedControl value. Uncontrolled (starts on open) when omitted.

onConfirm.note: (id) => void. Confirm, outline, on open rows.

onCorrect.note: (id, correction) => void. Correct turns the row into a focused Input; Enter or Save sends, Escape or Cancel goes back. Corrected rows show the old text struck through, the new text and "agent will redo n steps".

compact.note: One line: open count Badge, the weakest open assumption and its confidence.

limit.note: Rows shown before a "Show n more" ghost Button; 0 shows every row.

requirements: the Card is aria-labelledby its title; compact is a section named by the title
confidence is a Meter with an accessible name plus the word Low, Medium or High, never colour alone
the filter is a kit SegmentedControl named "Show assumptions"
"n steps" is a Button that opens a kit Popover named "Steps that use this assumption"
"Show n more" moves focus to the first new row
Correct focuses a labelled Input; Enter saves, Escape cancels, and focus returns to the row
corrected text uses del and ins with hidden "Was" / "Now" words
motion is opacity and transform only, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local GuessList, AssumptionCard or ConfidenceBar
Do not show confidence as colour alone
Do not use it for questions the agent waits on (DecisionCard)
snippet: <AssumptionLog items={[{ id: "cur", text: "Prices are in EUR", confidence: 0.42, source: "default", steps: ["Read supplier sheet", "Convert prices", "Write EU list"], status: "open" }]} onConfirm={confirm} onCorrect={correct} />
